documents.notes: UC Berkeley 'Requirements for International Students'. Applicants self-report their academic record in the UC application (no transcript at application). Not drafted: Non-immigrant Information Form (after admission), optional InitialView interview materials.

items.quote: If your curriculum requires further certification (examination results such as French Baccalaureate, IGCSE, A Levels, ATAR, etc.) you will also be required to submit those for the official academic record once admitted.
items.condition: once admitted, if the curriculum requires further certification (examination results)

items.quote: English Proficiency Exams and Minimum Score Requirements Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) with a minimum score of 90/4.5 or better
items.condition: English proficiency not shown otherwise (3+ years of English language of instruction, AP/IB English or ACT/SAT scores)

items.quote: A guarantee by the applicant's financial sponsor proving sufficient funds for the first year of study is required.
